name: exchange-mailbox-size-assessment
title: Exchange Online Mailbox Size Assessment
shortDescription: This script connects to Exchange Online, lists user mailboxes, calculates mailbox sizes, and exports the largest mailboxes to a CSV report.
longDescription: Assesses mailbox growth across Exchange Online by collecting mailbox statistics, ranking the largest mailboxes, and exporting a timestamped CSV report with item counts and last logon details.

thumbnails.alt: Preview of the sample Exchange Online Mailbox Size Assessment

references.name: Exchange Online PowerShell module
references.description: Learn how to connect to Exchange Online and use Exchange Online PowerShell cmdlets.
